summary: Interactive scientific dashboard, literature explorer, and conversational AI copilot that assists aerospace engineers, researchers, and mission safety officers in predictive modeling of material flammability, flame spread, and fire precursors in microgravity spaceflight environments.
details:
El Ignifugo is an interactive scientific telemetry platform and autonomous AI copilot designed to evaluate spacecraft fire safety and material flammability in microgravity. Grounding calculations in empirical data from 24 NASA Physical Sciences Informatics (PSI) flight investigations (ISS CIR, Cygnus Saffire I–VI, Space Shuttle, and Drop Towers).

Integrating an autonomous LangGraph AI Copilot powered by Google Gemini, which directly receives live active telemetry state to explain flammability margins, fire dynamics, and flight data.

Enables researchers, engineers, and students to search, filter, and inspect 24 historical NASA flight missions and over 150 related publications in one unified interface.

  • Core Languages & Web Framework: Python 3.12, Plotly Dash (Dash Core Components, Dash Bootstrap Components), Flask.
  • AI & Agent Architecture: LangGraph, LangChain, Google Gemini API, stateful telemetry injection graph.
  • Scientific Computing & Modeling: NumPy, SciPy (numerical interpolation, flammability boundary modeling, Thornton combustion energy scaling).
  • Frontend & Styling: Custom HUD CSS, Darkly Bootstrap 5, monospace typewriter typography, responsive viewport architecture.
  • Testing & Quality Assurance: Pytest (12 automated unit and physics verification tests), Playwright (automated mobile and desktop UI audits).
  • Infrastructure & Deployment: Git, GitHub, Docker, Gunicorn WSGI, and Render Cloud Hosting.
  • Background Images: Chatgpt and Gemini.
  • Spec Driven Development AI assisted: Antigravity IDE
